verdict.rationale: AI Gateway offers an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint that reaches multiple providers through a single URL, and you switch providers by changing the model and apiKey parameters. That implies one consistent request schema across providers, but no evidence explicitly says tool or function calls are supported or normalized through it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tool/function-calling support on the unified endpoint, evidence of consistent tool schemas being translated across providers like Anthropic and Gemini, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
